OPERATIONAL FRAMEWORK

How Operations Drive Analytics Excellence

High-quality sports analytics requires impeccable ground-truth data. Here are the core pillars that guide my daily operations.

Data Quality & Accuracy

Rigorous quality checks across delivery coding, scorecards, commentary, and event metadata to ensure zero discrepancies.

Squad Leadership (5–6 Analysts)

Active coordination of analyst shifts, match allocations, real-time live scoring oversight, and productivity standards.

Dev & Bug Resolution

Investigating edge-case data anomalies and working directly with software developers to patch bugs in scoring tools.

Actionable Performance BI

Translating ball-by-ball metrics into intuitive Power BI, Tableau, and visual summaries for coaches, teams, and platforms.
